import { chmodSync, copyFileSync, mkdtempSync } from "node:fs";
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { join, dirname } from "node:path";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { test } from "node:test";
const fixtures = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "echo-program.txt");
test("runs the echo fixture program on its input", () => {
  const program = join(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "echo-")), "echo");
  copyFileSync(fixtures, program);
  chmodSync(program, 0o755);
  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [program], { input: "hello", env: { ...process.env, PATH: process.env.PATH } });
  if (result.status !== 0) throw new Error(`echo exited with ${result.status}`);
});
